Application Materials.content:
Your application will only be processed when SMU has received all the documents and payment. Required application materials for the MEI include:
- An updated Resume
- Official academic transcripts of all educational institutions attended.
- 2 Personal Statements:
1. Explain in approximately 500 words tell us (a) your motivation in taking up the MSc in Entrepreneurship and Innovation (MEI), and (b) in what ways you will contribute to learning in the classroom.
2. In approximately 300 words, (i) provide an example of your involvement in creating something new: a business, a product or service, or a personal idea. Do include your role, reflections and the significance it has made. (ii) Describe a situation with the greatest ethical complexity that you have faced in your professional or academic life, and how your input helped resolve it.
- 2 Referee Reports - Submit 2 complete sets of referee details during the online process of applying for the MEI. The application portal will automatically send an email to your referees for them to complete an online recommendation form once you have submitted the application.
- Copy of NRIC/FIN/Passport (in PDF or JPEG format.
- Any other supporting documents
Scholarship application materials include essays for certain awards:
- Leadership Scholarship Essay: “Please explain in 500 words why you consider yourself a leader"
- Impact on Asia Essay: “Please explain in 500 words the professional development, entrepreneurial or personal projects of an Asian focus, that have contributed positively to Asian regions or companies or have increased awareness of Asia in other locations."
- Women in Business Essay: “Please explain in 500 words why you should be awarded with the Women in Business Scholarship”.
- Community Impact Essay: “Please share an example of how you have impacted your greater community and what you think is the best way to serve society”.

Interview Requirements.content: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an **online interview within two weeks of the application**.

Academic Requirements.content:
- **Bachelor's Degree** / **Good undergraduate degree (in any field)**.
- **1 to 5 years of work experience**; all other candidates can also be considered depending on their motivation and previous experience.
- Candidates should be passionate about new value creation in business and society.
- **SMU graduates with cumulative GPAs of 3.0/4.0 or better**, and graduates from local Autonomous Universities (**NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, SIT**) with **cumulative GPAs of 3.5/5.0 or better** will not require a GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test Score for admissions. An undergraduate GPA is valid for **5 years after graduation**. Meeting the above GPA academic criteria does not guarantee admission.
- Verification of original documents is required upon matriculation into the programme. Failing to do so may result in applicants having to withdraw from the programme.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- Pre-requisites include: Bachelor's Degree; **GMAT / GRE / SMU Admissions Test**; TOEFL / IELTS if the medium of instruction of undergraduate studies was not in English.
- Application requirements include **a good GMAT / GRE / *SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT) score**.
- **SMU graduates with cumulative GPAs of 3.0/4.0 or better**, and graduates from local Autonomous Universities (NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, SIT) with **cumulative GPAs of 3.5/5.0 or better** will not require a GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test Score for admissions. An undergraduate GPA is valid for **5 years after graduation**. Please note that meeting the above GPA academic criteria does not guarantee admission. Candidates may still be advised to submit GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test scores to further strengthen their application.
- If you have not taken the GMAT or GRE, you are encouraged to take the SMU Admissions Test. Alternatively, you may first submit your online application and arrange for the GMAT / GRE test to be taken as soon as possible. Do include the date of your test as well.

English Proficiency Requirements.content: TOEFL / IELTS (if the medium of instruction of your undergraduate studies was not in English)

Program Overview.content:
The SMU Master of Science in Entrepreneurship and Innovation (MEI) offers a cross-disciplinary, practice-driven education through world-class faculty, close engagement with thought-leading practitioners, global exposure at a leading business school, and hands-on innovation projects. Designed to engage, challenge, and grow Asia’s next generation of innovation and entrepreneurial leaders, MEI prepares graduates to create, scale, and lead in dynamic innovation ecosystems.
The full-time MEI is a 12-month programme. It is designed to equip aspiring leaders with the capabilities to lead innovation in both large organisations or breakthrough start-ups, and to ensure students acquire knowledge and competencies to successfully tackle today’s and tomorrow’s innovation challenges in various sectors. Candidates who are passionate about new value creation in business and society are identified as a target audience.
Students are required to complete **15 Credit Units** to be awarded the MEI degree: 7.0CU Core Modules, 2.0CU Electives, 4CU Venture Building Experiences, 1CU Postgraduate Professional Development Course and 1CU Overseas Immersion Programme. The programme includes a Venture Building Experience co-led by faculty, industry partners and leading venture capitalists, plus an Overseas Immersion Programme. The current partner for the international residency segment is University College London; part of the MEI curriculum involves a one-week residency at University College London.
MEI highlights include learning from eminent faculty with Ph.D. from Cornell, Harvard, INSEAD, Oxford, Stanford, Yale and other universities, industry partners and leading venture capitalists; entrepreneurial learning and exposure in partnership with University College London; and engagement with startups, founders, and innovation leaders in London.
Class profile: gender ratio 11:9, average age 36, and average years of work experience 11. Student profiles are taken from Classes of 2018-2021 (Full-time & Part-time).
Industries MEI graduates work in include Commodities 3%, Education 8%, Business / Financial Services 18%, Government Agencies 7%, Hospitality 6%, Pharmaceutical & Healthcare 3%, Manufacturing 8%, Media & Advertising 4%, Technology 18%, Transportation & Logistics 9%, Research 3%, and Others 13%. Industry diversity data was collated from graduating students from 2020 and 2021.
Alumni examples include Khairulnizam Zulkifle, Senior Manager, Transformation Office, Wildlife Reserves Singapore, Class of 2020; Tom Lee, Associate Aerosol Engineer, Philip Morris International, Class of 2021; and Giovanna Claro, Founder and CEO, eHeadset English Online, Class of 2021.

Curriculum.content:
The full-time MSc in Entrepreneurship and Innovation offers a comprehensive curriculum. The programme runs **12 months full-time**, with a **Full-time 15 Months Capstone** option shown in the programme calendar.
Students are required to complete **15 Credit Units** to be awarded the MEI degree, including:
- **7.0 CU Core Modules**
- **2.0 CU Electives**
- **4 CU Venture Building Experiences**
- **1 CU Postgraduate Professional Development Course**
- **1 CU Overseas Immersion Programme**
Programme calendar:
| Term | Duration | Curriculum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Term 1** Aug to Nov | 12 Weeks | Strategic Management; Financing of New Ventures; Venture Building Experience 1: Entrepreneurial Mindset; Postgraduate Professional Development Course |
| **Term 1A** Nov to Dec | 5 Weeks | Artificial Intelligence and Future Trends*; Business Ethics*; Venture Building Experience 2: Managing Teams |
| **Term 2** Jan to Apr | 12 Weeks | Prototyping and Product Development; Entrepreneurial Marketing Strategy and Branding; Innovation Management; Venture Building Experience 3: Minimum Viable Product |
| **Term 3** Apr to Jun | 12 Weeks | Business Acceleration and Growth Strategy; Management of Human Capital in Organisations; Innovation in Supply Chain: A Risk Management Perspective*; Open elective**; Venture Building Experience 4: Go To Markets |
| **Term 3A** Jul to Aug | 5 Weeks | One-week overseas segment; Global Entrepreneurship & Innovation Immersion |
*Elective module. Programme information is subject to change.
Course units listed include:
- Strategic Management — **Course Unit: 1**
- Financing of New Ventures — **Course Unit: 1**
- Entrepreneurial Mindset — **Course Unit: 1**
- AI & Future Trends — **Course Unit: 0.5**

- Prototyping and Product Development — **Course Unit: 1**
- Entrepreneurial Marketing Strategy & Branding — **Course Unit: 1**
- Innovation Management — **Course Unit: 1**
- Minimum Viable Product — **Course Unit: 1**
- Business Acceleration and Growth Strategy — **Course Unit: 1**
- Management of Human Capital in Organisation — **Course Unit: 1**
- Innovation in Supply Chain: A Risk Management Perspective — **Course Unit: 0.5**
- Business Ethics — **Course Unit: 0.5**
- Go To Market — **Course Unit: 1**
- Global Entrepreneurship and Innovation Immersion — **Course Unit: 1**
The Venture Building Experience sequence includes Entrepreneurial Mindset, Managing Teams, Minimum Viable Product, and Go To Market. Part of the MSc in Entrepreneurship & Innovation (MEI) curriculum involves a one-week residency at University College London. The Global Entrepreneurship and Innovation Immersion gives students the opportunity to travel overseas and build networks and connections beyond Singapore.

Cost of Attendance.content:

| Item | Cost Per Month |
| --- | --- |
| **Accommodation** | **S$250 - S$800** |
| **Utilities** | **S$40 - S$100** |
| **Transportation** | **S$200** |
| **Telecommunications** | **S$50** |
| **Books & Stationery** | **S$200 per term** |
| **Personal Expenses (mobile phone, meals, etc)** | **S$100 - S$300** |
| **Food** | **S$300 - S$450** |

Financial Aid.content:
Academic Excellence | Global Awareness | SMU-ASEAN | Leadership* | Impact on Asia* | Women in Business* | Community Impact*
\* Denotes Scholarships that students can apply for upon admissions into the programme
These scholarships entail award amounts up to 30% of the tuition fee, with no bonds attached. **The Admissions Scholarship Committee will assess the following:**
- Professional, personal, and academic achievements
- Evidence of making an entrepreneurial impact to business/society
- Interview Performance
- Recommendation from the Academic Director
Academic Excellence: The SMU MEI will offer the Academic Excellence Award to high-quality candidates with exceptional academic performance. Awards are based on academic merit, final grades and admissions test score.
Global Awareness: The SMU MEI is committed to crafting a diverse and global academic environment that will contribute to the student’s personal and professional journey. The Global Awareness Award is awarded to individuals who will contribute to the class room diversity and enrich the learning experience of students by way of cultural, personal or professional backgrounds.
SMU-ASEAN: The SMU-ASEAN Scholarships do not require any applications. Applicants who meet the criteria below will be considered. The award amounts range from S$5,000 to S$10,000 (inclusive of GST) with no bonds attached to the scholarships. **Eligibility criteria:**
1. Successful admission into the SMU MEI Programme
2. Open to nationals of ASEAN member countries
Leadership: The SMU MEI recognises individuals with strong leadership capabilities who have exhibited outstanding leadership potential in their profession, organisation or community with the Leadership Scholarship. Applicants must demonstrate strong leadership capabilities or potential in personal and professional instances. **The Admissions Scholarship Committee will assess the following:**
1. Interview Performance
2. Essay: “Please explain in 500 words why you consider yourself a leader"
3. Leadership quality recognition such as workplace career progression, line management progression, professional recognition, project success and team leadership; leadership qualities during student days; attainment of any non-academic awards and scholarships.
Impact on Asia: The SMU MEI is creating a significant impact in Singapore, extending now to Asia. We look forward to welcoming students who can demonstrate achievements in their professional, social and personal life that have created an impact on Asia. **The Admissions Scholarship Committee will assess the following:**
1. Interview Performance
2. Essay: “Please explain in 500 words the professional development, entrepreneurial or personal projects of an Asian focus, that have contributed positively to Asian regions or companies or have increased awareness of Asia in other locations."
3. Impact: reach of impact, entrepreneurial projects, awards and helping the increased awareness of Asia will be taken into consideration.
Women in Business: The SMU MEI aims to recognise exceptional women with the “Women in Business” Award, those who have demonstrated outstanding leadership capabilities or potential in their professional or personal endeavours. Applicants must have successfully received an admissions offer. **The Admissions Scholarship Committee will assess the following:**
1. Interview Performance
2. Essay: “Please explain in 500 words why you should be awarded with the Women in Business Scholarship”.
3. Leadership quality recognition such as workplace career progression, line management progression, professional recognition, project success and team leadership; leadership qualities during student days; attainment of any non-academic awards and scholarships.
Community Impact: The "Community Impact Award" recognises candidates who have contributed to society through outstanding community work and through their actions, have impacted members of the community/society in a positive manner. **The Admissions Scholarship Committee will assess the following:**
1. Interview Performance
2. Essay: “Please share an example of how you have impacted your greater community and what you think is the best way to serve society”.
3. Impact of Community Work: frequency and reach. Awards and recognition will be considered.
Lee Kuan Yew Scholarship: **Eligibility criteria:**
1. A Singapore citizen with at least a Second Upper Honours Degree or equivalent Degree
2. Excellent track record of leadership and service
Applicants should preferably have at least four years of working experience. Includes S$10,000 one-off and up to S$50,000 annual allowance. [Find out more](https://www.psc.gov.sg/home)
Arief Budiman and Henny Taslim Indonesian Scholarship: Awarded to exceptional postgraduate Indonesian students. **Eligibility criteria:**
1. Candidates shall be full-time incoming postgraduate students at the University who are citizens of Indonesia.
2. Candidates must demonstrate academic excellence in their applications, in line with the University policies.
This is a full scholarship covering the entire duration of postgraduate studies at SMU.
SkillsFuture Funding for Singapore Citizens: [Click on this link for more details.](https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/credit)
The SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme provides Singapore Citizens aged 40 years and above the opportunity to receive the SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top up of $4,000. This credit is intended to offset out-of-pocket tuition fees, starting from Academic Year 2026/27 intake, commencing on or after 1 May 2026. Please visit [https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/level-up-programme](https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/level-up-programme) for further details.
**SMU Alumni**: SMU is committed to lifelong learning. Graduates from SMU undergraduate or postgraduate programmes are automatically eligible for an alumni discount of S$8,000 when applying to the MEI programme.
**Singapore Local Autonomous University**: Graduates from the following local universities: National University of Singapore (NUS), Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS), Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), or Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT), are automatically eligible for an alumni discount of S$4,000 when applying to the MEI programme. Eligible candidates may receive exemptions for up to four credit units, with a discount of $3,000 awarded for each credit unit exempted.
**SG/PR**: Singaporean citizens and Permanent Residents are eligible for a one-time discount of S$5,000.
**ASEAN Citizens**: ASEAN citizens are eligible for a one-time discount of S$3,000. (Brunei Darussalam, Myanmar, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam)
**Corporate Partner**: Eligible company-sponsored candidates are eligible for a one-time discount of S$6,000. Contact our admissions team to discuss your eligibility.
- The above discounts are applicable to students joining the programme from the January 2025 intake onwards.
- Each student is only eligible for one discount. Should a student qualify for more than one discount, only the higher discount will be applicable.
- The above tuition fee discount is deductable before Goods and Services Tax (GST).
- SMU reserves the right to change these exemptions at any point in time.

Multiple Applications.content: If you have applied for multiple programmes, please contact the programme office of your first choice to register for the administration of the test. Once you have completed the test, do update the other programme office(s) upon the completion of your test via email to ensure timely processing of all your SMU applications.
